import Mathlib

structure SCCGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def SCCGraph.well_formed (g : SCCGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def SCCGraph.size (g : SCCGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def SCCGraph.has_edge (g : SCCGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def SCCGraph.is_path (g : SCCGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def SCCGraph.has_path (g : SCCGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v

def SCCGraph.is_strongly_connected (g : SCCGraph) (comp : List Nat) : Prop :=
  comp.length > 0 ∧
  (∀ u, u ∈ comp → u < g.size) ∧
  ∀ u v, u ∈ comp → v ∈ comp →
    (g.has_path u v ∧ g.has_path v u)

def SCCGraph.is_partition (g : SCCGraph) (sccs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  -- Enforce no duplicate components to match index-based disjointness
  sccs.Nodup ∧ 
  -- All nodes covered
  (∀ u, u < g.size → ∃ comp, comp ∈ sccs ∧ u ∈ comp) ∧
  -- Disjoint
  (∀ c1 c2, c1 ∈ sccs → c2 ∈ sccs → c1 ≠ c2 →
    ∀ u, u ∈ c1 → u ∉ c2)

def SCCGraph.scc_has_path (g : SCCGraph) (c1 c2 : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ u v, u ∈ c1 ∧ v ∈ c2 ∧ g.has_path u v

def SCCGraph.is_maximal_scc_structure (g : SCCGraph) (sccs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∀ c1 c2, c1 ∈ sccs → c2 ∈ sccs → c1 ≠ c2 →
    (g.scc_has_path c1 c2 → ¬ g.scc_has_path c2 c1)

def SCCGraph.is_valid_scc_result (g : SCCGraph) (sccs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  g.is_partition sccs ∧
  (∀ c, c ∈ sccs → g.is_strongly_connected c) ∧
  g.is_maximal_scc_structure sccs

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def find_sccs_precond (graph : SCCGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧ graph.size ≤ 1000
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
namespace SCCImpl

def outNbrs (g : SCCGraph) (u : Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  if u < g.adj.size then ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList).toFinset else ∅

def expand (g : SCCGraph) (S : Finset Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  S ∪ S.biUnion (fun w => outNbrs g w)

def reachSet (g : SCCGraph) (u : Nat) : Nat → Finset Nat
  | 0 => {u}
  | k + 1 => expand g (reachSet g u k)

def Rch (g : SCCGraph) (u v : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (v ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size)

def sccOf (g : SCCGraph) (u : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range g.adj.size).filter (fun v => Rch g u v && Rch g v u)

end SCCImpl
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def find_sccs (graph : SCCGraph)
    (h_precond : find_sccs_precond graph) : List (List Nat) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  ((List.range graph.adj.size).map (SCCImpl.sccOf graph)).dedup
-- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def find_sccs_postcond (graph : SCCGraph) (result : List (List Nat))
    (_ : find_sccs_precond graph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  graph.is_valid_scc_result result
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
namespace SCCImpl

theorem rs0 (g : SCCGraph) (u : Nat) : reachSet g u 0 = {u} := by
  first | rfl | simp [reachSet]

theorem rsS (g : SCCGraph) (u k : Nat) :
    reachSet g u (k + 1) = expand g (reachSet g u k) := by
  first | rfl | simp [reachSet]

theorem mem_outNbrs {g : SCCGraph} {u v : Nat} : v ∈ outNbrs g u ↔ g.has_edge u v := by
  unfold outNbrs SCCGraph.has_edge
  by_cases h : u < g.adj.size
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h]

theorem sub_expand {g : SCCGraph} (S : Finset Nat) : S ⊆ expand g S := by
  intro x hx
  simp only [expand, Finset.mem_union]
  exact Or.inl hx

theorem expand_mono {g : SCCGraph} {S T : Finset Nat} (h : S ⊆ T) :
    expand g S ⊆ expand g T := by
  intro x hx
  simp only [expand, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion] at hx ⊢
  rcases hx with hx | ⟨w, hw, hx⟩
  · exact Or.inl (h hx)
  · exact Or.inr ⟨w, h hw, hx⟩

theorem rs_mono {g : SCCGraph} {u : Nat} :
    ∀ {k m : Nat}, k ≤ m → reachSet g u k ⊆ reachSet g u m := by
  intro k m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro h
    have hk : k = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp h
    subst hk
    exact fun x hx => hx
  | succ m ih =>
    intro h
    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le h with heq | hlt
    · subst heq
      exact fun x hx => hx
    · have h1 := ih (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hlt)
      intro x hx
      rw [rsS]
      exact sub_expand _ (h1 hx)

theorem rs_range {g : SCCGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {u : Nat} (hu : u < g.adj.size) :
    ∀ (k : Nat), reachSet g u k ⊆ Finset.range g.adj.size := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    rw [rs0]
    intro x hx
    have hxu : x = u := by simpa using hx
    subst hxu
    simpa using hu
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [rsS]
    intro x hx
    simp only [expand, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion] at hx
    rcases hx with hx | ⟨w, hw, hx⟩
    · exact ih hx
    · exact Finset.mem_range.mpr
        (hwf w (Finset.mem_range.mp (ih hw)) x (mem_outNbrs.mp hx).2)

theorem card_low {g : SCCGraph} {u : Nat}
    (hne : ∀ k, k ≤ g.adj.size → reachSet g u (k + 1) ≠ reachSet g u k) :
    ∀ k, k ≤ g.adj.size → k + 1 ≤ (reachSet g u k).card := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro _
    rw [rs0]
    simp
  | succ k ih =>
    intro hk
    have hk' : k ≤ g.adj.size := Nat.le_of_succ_le hk
    have h1 := ih hk'
    have hsub : reachSet g u k ⊆ reachSet g u (k + 1) := rs_mono (Nat.le_succ k)
    have hne' : reachSet g u k ≠ reachSet g u (k + 1) := fun hh => hne k hk' hh.symm
    have hss : reachSet g u k ⊂ reachSet g u (k + 1) := by
      first
        | exact Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨hsub, hne'⟩
        | exact lt_of_le_of_ne hsub hne'
    have h2 := Finset.card_lt_card hss
    omega

theorem exists_stable {g : SCCGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {u : Nat} (hu : u < g.adj.size) :
    ∃ k, k ≤ g.adj.size ∧ reachSet g u (k + 1) = reachSet g u k := by
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc
  have h1 := card_low (g := g) (u := u) (fun k hk => hc k hk) g.adj.size (le_refl _)
  have h2 : (reachSet g u g.adj.size).card ≤ (Finset.range g.adj.size).card :=
    Finset.card_le_card (rs_range hwf hu g.adj.size)
  rw [Finset.card_range] at h2
  omega

theorem stable_all {g : SCCGraph} {u k : Nat}
    (h : reachSet g u (k + 1) = reachSet g u k) :
    ∀ m, k ≤ m → reachSet g u m = reachSet g u k := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro hm
    have hk : k = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hm
    subst hk
    rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    intro hm
    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hm with heq | hlt
    · rw [heq]
    · have h1 : reachSet g u m = reachSet g u k := ih (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hlt)
      calc reachSet g u (m + 1) = expand g (reachSet g u m) := rsS g u m
        _ = expand g (reachSet g u k) := by rw [h1]
        _ = reachSet g u (k + 1) := (rsS g u k).symm
        _ = reachSet g u k := h

theorem expand_rs {g : SCCGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {u : Nat} (hu : u < g.adj.size) :
    expand g (reachSet g u g.adj.size) = reachSet g u g.adj.size := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hs⟩ := exists_stable hwf hu
  have h1 : reachSet g u g.adj.size = reachSet g u k := stable_all hs _ hk
  have h2 : reachSet g u (g.adj.size + 1) = reachSet g u k :=
    stable_all hs _ (Nat.le_succ_of_le hk)
  calc expand g (reachSet g u g.adj.size)
      = reachSet g u (g.adj.size + 1) := (rsS g u g.adj.size).symm
    _ = reachSet g u k := h2
    _ = reachSet g u g.adj.size := h1.symm

theorem reach_refl {g : SCCGraph} (u : Nat) : u ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size := by
  have h0 : u ∈ reachSet g u 0 := by
    rw [rs0]
    simp
  exact rs_mono (Nat.zero_le _) h0

theorem reach_trans {g : SCCGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {u v w : Nat} (hu : u < g.adj.size)
    (h1 : v ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size) (h2 : w ∈ reachSet g v g.adj.size) :
    w ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size := by
  have key : ∀ k, reachSet g v k ⊆ reachSet g u g.adj.size := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      rw [rs0]
      intro x hx
      have hxv : x = v := by simpa using hx
      subst hxv
      exact h1
    | succ k ih =>
      intro x hx
      rw [rsS] at hx
      have hx2 : x ∈ expand g (reachSet g u g.adj.size) := expand_mono ih hx
      rwa [expand_rs hwf hu] at hx2
  exact key _ h2

theorem reach_edge {g : SCCGraph} {u v : Nat} (h : g.has_edge u v) :
    v ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size := by
  have hu : u < g.adj.size := h.1
  have h0 : v ∈ expand g (reachSet g u 0) := by
    simp only [expand, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion]
    refine Or.inr ⟨u, ?_, mem_outNbrs.mpr h⟩
    rw [rs0]
    simp
  have h1 : v ∈ reachSet g u (0 + 1) := by
    rw [rsS]
    exact h0
  exact rs_mono (by omega) h1

theorem gD0 (x : Nat) (t : List Nat) : (x :: t).getD 0 0 = x := by
  first | rfl | simp

theorem gDS (x : Nat) (t : List Nat) (i : Nat) :
    (x :: t).getD (i + 1) 0 = t.getD i 0 := by
  first | rfl | simp

theorem hd_cons (x : Nat) (t : List Nat) : (x :: t).head? = some x := by
  first | rfl | simp

theorem last_single (x : Nat) : ([x] : List Nat).getLast? = some x := by
  first | rfl | simp

theorem last_cc (x y : Nat) (t : List Nat) :
    (x :: y :: t).getLast? = (y :: t).getLast? := by
  first | rfl | simp

theorem last_snoc : ∀ (l : List Nat) (v : Nat), (l ++ [v]).getLast? = some v := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro v
    first | rfl | simp
  | cons x t ih =>
    intro v
    cases t with
    | nil => first | rfl | simp
    | cons y t' =>
      have h1 : ((x :: y :: t') ++ [v]).getLast? = (y :: (t' ++ [v])).getLast? := by
        show (x :: y :: (t' ++ [v])).getLast? = (y :: (t' ++ [v])).getLast?
        exact last_cc x y (t' ++ [v])
      rw [h1]
      exact ih v

theorem chain_idx (g : SCCGraph) : ∀ (p : List Nat),
    (∀ i, i + 1 < p.length → g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)) ↔
      List.IsChain g.has_edge p := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil =>
    constructor
    · intro _
      exact List.IsChain.nil
    · intro _ i hi
      simp only [List.length_nil] at hi
      omega
  | cons x t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      constructor
      · intro _
        exact List.IsChain.singleton x
      · intro _ i hi
        simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hi
        omega
    | cons y t' =>
      rw [List.isChain_cons_cons, ← ih]
      constructor
      · intro h
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · have e := h 0 (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)
          first
            | (rw [gD0, gDS, gD0] at e; exact e)
            | (simp only [gD0, gDS] at e; exact e)
            | simpa [gD0, gDS] using e
        · intro i hi
          have e := h (i + 1) (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢; omega)
          first
            | (rw [gDS, gDS] at e; exact e)
            | (simp only [gDS] at e; exact e)
            | simpa [gDS] using e
      · intro h i hi
        cases i with
        | zero =>
          have hh := h.1
          first
            | (rw [gD0, gDS, gD0]; exact hh)
            | (simp only [gD0, gDS]; exact hh)
            | simpa [gD0, gDS] using hh
        | succ j =>
          have hh := h.2 j (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢; omega)
          first
            | (rw [gDS, gDS]; exact hh)
            | (simp only [gDS]; exact hh)
            | simpa [gDS] using hh

theorem path_chain (g : SCCGraph) (p : List Nat) :
    g.is_path p ↔ (p ≠ [] ∧ List.IsChain g.has_edge p) := by
  unfold SCCGraph.is_path
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨?_, (chain_idx g p).mp h2⟩
    cases p with
    | nil => simp at h1
    | cons a t => simp
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨?_, (chain_idx g p).mpr h2⟩
    cases p with
    | nil => exact absurd rfl h1
    | cons a t => simp

theorem chain_snoc (g : SCCGraph) : ∀ (l : List Nat) (w v : Nat),
    List.IsChain g.has_edge l → l.getLast? = some w → g.has_edge w v →
    List.IsChain g.has_edge (l ++ [v]) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro w v _ hl _
    simp at hl
  | cons x t ih =>
    intro w v hc hl he
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      have hx : x = w := Option.some_inj.mp ((last_single x).symm.trans hl)
      subst hx
      refine List.isChain_cons_cons.mpr ⟨he, ?_⟩
      exact List.IsChain.singleton v
    | cons y t' =>
      rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at hc
      have hl' : (y :: t').getLast? = some w := by
        rw [← last_cc x y t']
        exact hl
      exact List.isChain_cons_cons.mpr ⟨hc.1, ih w v hc.2 hl' he⟩

theorem path_snoc {g : SCCGraph} {u w v : Nat} (h1 : g.has_path u w)
    (h2 : g.has_edge w v) : g.has_path u v := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hh, hl⟩ := h1
  rw [path_chain] at hp
  obtain ⟨hne, hc⟩ := hp
  cases p with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl hne
  | cons x t =>
    have hx : x = u := Option.some_inj.mp ((hd_cons x t).symm.trans hh)
    refine ⟨(x :: t) ++ [v], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [path_chain]
      exact ⟨by simp, chain_snoc g (x :: t) w v hc hl h2⟩
    · have hh2 : ((x :: t) ++ [v]).head? = some x := by
        show (x :: (t ++ [v])).head? = some x
        exact hd_cons x (t ++ [v])
      rw [hh2, hx]
    · exact last_snoc (x :: t) v

theorem path_of_mem {g : SCCGraph} (u : Nat) :
    ∀ (k v : Nat), v ∈ reachSet g u k → g.has_path u v := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro v hv
    rw [rs0] at hv
    have hvu : v = u := by simpa using hv
    refine ⟨[u], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [path_chain]
      exact ⟨by simp, List.IsChain.singleton u⟩
    · exact hd_cons u []
    · rw [last_single u, hvu]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro v hv
    rw [rsS] at hv
    simp only [expand, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion] at hv
    rcases hv with hv | ⟨w, hw, hv⟩
    · exact ih v hv
    · exact path_snoc (ih w hw) (mem_outNbrs.mp hv)

theorem mem_of_chain {g : SCCGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat), List.IsChain g.has_edge p → ∀ (u v : Nat),
      p.head? = some u → p.getLast? = some v → v ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil =>
    intro _ u v hh _
    simp at hh
  | cons x t ih =>
    intro hc u v hh hl
    have hx : x = u := Option.some_inj.mp ((hd_cons x t).symm.trans hh)
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      have hv : x = v := Option.some_inj.mp ((last_single x).symm.trans hl)
      rw [← hx, ← hv]
      exact reach_refl x
    | cons y t' =>
      rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at hc
      have hl' : (y :: t').getLast? = some v := by
        rw [← last_cc x y t']
        exact hl
      have hy : v ∈ reachSet g y g.adj.size := ih hc.2 y v (hd_cons y t') hl'
      have hres : v ∈ reachSet g x g.adj.size :=
        reach_trans hwf hc.1.1 (reach_edge hc.1) hy
      rw [← hx]
      exact hres

theorem mem_of_path {g : SCCGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {u v : Nat}
    (h : g.has_path u v) : v ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hh, hl⟩ := h
  rw [path_chain] at hp
  exact mem_of_chain hwf p hp.2 u v hh hl

theorem mem_sccOf {g : SCCGraph} {u v : Nat} :
    v ∈ sccOf g u ↔
      (v < g.adj.size ∧ v ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size ∧ u ∈ reachSet g v g.adj.size) := by
  unfold sccOf Rch
  rw [List.mem_filter]
  simp [List.mem_range]

theorem sccOf_eq {g : SCCGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {a b : Nat}
    (ha : a < g.adj.size) (hb : b < g.adj.size)
    (hab : b ∈ reachSet g a g.adj.size) (hba : a ∈ reachSet g b g.adj.size) :
    sccOf g a = sccOf g b := by
  have hfun : (fun v => Rch g a v && Rch g v a) = (fun v => Rch g b v && Rch g v b) := by
    funext v
    by_cases hv : v < g.adj.size
    · have hiff : (v ∈ reachSet g a g.adj.size ∧ a ∈ reachSet g v g.adj.size) ↔
          (v ∈ reachSet g b g.adj.size ∧ b ∈ reachSet g v g.adj.size) := by
        constructor
        · intro h
          exact ⟨reach_trans hwf hb hba h.1, reach_trans hwf hv h.2 hab⟩
        · intro h
          exact ⟨reach_trans hwf ha hab h.1, reach_trans hwf hv h.2 hba⟩
      have hdec : (decide (v ∈ reachSet g a g.adj.size ∧ a ∈ reachSet g v g.adj.size)) =
          (decide (v ∈ reachSet g b g.adj.size ∧ b ∈ reachSet g v g.adj.size)) :=
        decide_eq_decide.mpr hiff
      first
        | simpa [Rch, Bool.decide_and] using hdec
        | (rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff]
           simp only [Rch, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
           exact hiff)
    · have h1 : Rch g a v = false := by
        simp only [Rch, decide_eq_false_iff_not]
        intro hm
        exact hv (Finset.mem_range.mp (rs_range hwf ha g.adj.size hm))
      have h2 : Rch g b v = false := by
        simp only [Rch, decide_eq_false_iff_not]
        intro hm
        exact hv (Finset.mem_range.mp (rs_range hwf hb g.adj.size hm))
      rw [h1, h2]
      simp
  unfold sccOf
  rw [hfun]

end SCCImpl
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem find_sccs_postcond_satisfied (graph : SCCGraph)
    (h_precond : find_sccs_precond graph) :
    find_sccs_postcond graph (find_sccs graph h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have hwf : graph.well_formed := h_precond.1
  have hmem : ∀ c, c ∈ find_sccs graph h_precond ↔
      ∃ a, a < graph.adj.size ∧ SCCImpl.sccOf graph a = c := by
    intro c
    unfold find_sccs
    rw [List.mem_dedup, List.mem_map]
    simp [List.mem_range]
  have hself : ∀ a, a < graph.adj.size → a ∈ SCCImpl.sccOf graph a := by
    intro a ha
    rw [SCCImpl.mem_sccOf]
    exact ⟨ha, SCCImpl.reach_refl a, SCCImpl.reach_refl a⟩
  have hkey : ∀ a b, a < graph.adj.size → b < graph.adj.size →
      SCCImpl.sccOf graph a ≠ SCCImpl.sccOf graph b →
      ¬ (b ∈ SCCImpl.reachSet graph a graph.adj.size ∧
         a ∈ SCCImpl.reachSet graph b graph.adj.size) := by
    intro a b ha hb hne h
    exact hne (SCCImpl.sccOf_eq hwf ha hb h.1 h.2)
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold find_sccs
    exact List.nodup_dedup _
  · intro u hu
    have hu' : u < graph.adj.size := hu
    exact ⟨SCCImpl.sccOf graph u, (hmem _).mpr ⟨u, hu', rfl⟩, hself u hu'⟩
  · intro c1 c2 h1 h2 hne u hu1 hu2
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hac⟩ := (hmem c1).mp h1
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hbc⟩ := (hmem c2).mp h2
    subst hac
    subst hbc
    rw [SCCImpl.mem_sccOf] at hu1 hu2
    exact hkey a b ha hb hne
      ⟨SCCImpl.reach_trans hwf ha hu1.2.1 hu2.2.2,
       SCCImpl.reach_trans hwf hb hu2.2.1 hu1.2.2⟩
  · intro c hc
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hac⟩ := (hmem c).mp hc
    subst hac
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h := hself a ha
      cases hs : SCCImpl.sccOf graph a with

Your task is to implement Tarjan's Algorithm to find the Strongly Connected Components (SCCs) of a directed graph and verify its functional correctness in Lean using Mathlib. Preconditions: You can assume the graph contains at most 1,000 nodes. The graph is directed and represented as an adjacency list. Requirements: Implement the function find_sccs which returns a List (List Nat). Output Format: The result must be a list of lists, where each inner list represents one Strongly Connected Component. Partition: The set of returned components must form a partition of the graph vertices. Strong Connectivity: For every component returned, and for every pair of nodes $(u, v)$ within that component, there must exist a path $u \rightsquigarrow v$ AND a path $v \rightsquigarrow u$. Maximality: The components must be maximal. This means no two components can be merged to form a larger strongly connected set. Formally, if there is a path from Component A to Component B, there must be no path from Component B back to Component A (The "Condensation Graph" must be a DAG). Verification Challenges: (1) DFS Invariants: Tarjan's algorithm uses discovery_time and low_link values. (3) Maximality Proof: Proving that the algorithm does not "break" a large component into smaller valid pieces.

  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →

def SCCGraph.is_strongly_connected (g : SCCGraph) (comp : List Nat) : Prop :=
  comp.length > 0 ∧

  ∀ u v, u ∈ comp → v ∈ comp →

structure SCCGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def SCCGraph.well_formed (g : SCCGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def SCCGraph.size (g : SCCGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def SCCGraph.has_edge (g : SCCGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def SCCGraph.is_path (g : SCCGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def SCCGraph.has_path (g : SCCGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v

def SCCGraph.is_strongly_connected (g : SCCGraph) (comp : List Nat) : Prop :=
  comp.length > 0 ∧
  (∀ u, u ∈ comp → u < g.size) ∧
  ∀ u v, u ∈ comp → v ∈ comp →
    (g.has_path u v ∧ g.has_path v u)

def SCCGraph.is_partition (g : SCCGraph) (sccs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  -- Enforce no duplicate components to match index-based disjointness
  sccs.Nodup ∧ 
  -- All nodes covered
  (∀ u, u < g.size → ∃ comp, comp ∈ sccs ∧ u ∈ comp) ∧
  -- Disjoint
  (∀ c1 c2, c1 ∈ sccs → c2 ∈ sccs → c1 ≠ c2 →
    ∀ u, u ∈ c1 → u ∉ c2)

def SCCGraph.scc_has_path (g : SCCGraph) (c1 c2 : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ u v, u ∈ c1 ∧ v ∈ c2 ∧ g.has_path u v

def SCCGraph.is_maximal_scc_structure (g : SCCGraph) (sccs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∀ c1 c2, c1 ∈ sccs → c2 ∈ sccs → c1 ≠ c2 →
    (g.scc_has_path c1 c2 → ¬ g.scc_has_path c2 c1)

def SCCGraph.is_valid_scc_result (g : SCCGraph) (sccs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  g.is_partition sccs ∧
  (∀ c, c ∈ sccs → g.is_strongly_connected c) ∧
  g.is_maximal_scc_structure sccs

namespace SCCImpl

/-- The out-neighbours of `u` as a finite set (empty if `u` is not a vertex). -/
def outNbrs (g : SCCGraph) (u : Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  if u < g.adj.size then ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList).toFinset else ∅

/-- One step of saturation. -/
def expand (g : SCCGraph) (S : Finset Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  S ∪ S.biUnion (fun w => outNbrs g w)

/-- Vertices reachable from `u` using at most `k` edges. -/
def reachSet (g : SCCGraph) (u : Nat) : Nat → Finset Nat
  | 0 => {u}
  | k + 1 => expand g (reachSet g u k)

/-- Decidable reachability test. -/
def Rch (g : SCCGraph) (u v : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (v ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size)

/-- The strongly connected component of `u`. -/
def sccOf (g : SCCGraph) (u : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range g.adj.size).filter (fun v => Rch g u v && Rch g v u)

end SCCImpl

  -- !benchmark @start code
  ((List.range graph.adj.size).map (SCCImpl.sccOf graph)).dedup
  -- !benchmark @end code

namespace SCCImpl

theorem reachSet_zero (g : SCCGraph) (u : Nat) : reachSet g u 0 = {u} := by
  first
    | rfl
    | simp [reachSet]

theorem reachSet_succ (g : SCCGraph) (u k : Nat) :
    reachSet g u (k + 1) = expand g (reachSet g u k) := by
  first
    | rfl
    | simp [reachSet]

theorem mem_outNbrs {g : SCCGraph} {u v : Nat} : v ∈ outNbrs g u ↔ g.has_edge u v := by
  unfold outNbrs SCCGraph.has_edge
  by_cases h : u < g.adj.size
  · first
      | simp [h]
      | simp [h, Array.mem_def]
      | simp [h, Array.mem_toList]
  · simp [h]

theorem subset_expand {g : SCCGraph} (S : Finset Nat) : S ⊆ expand g S := by
  intro x hx
  simp only [expand, Finset.mem_union]
  exact Or.inl hx

theorem expand_mono {g : SCCGraph} {S T : Finset Nat} (h : S ⊆ T) :
    expand g S ⊆ expand g T := by
  intro x hx
  simp only [expand, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion] at hx ⊢
  rcases hx with hx | ⟨w, hw, hx⟩
  · exact Or.inl (h hx)
  · exact Or.inr ⟨w, h hw, hx⟩

theorem reachSet_mono {g : SCCGraph} {u : Nat} :
    ∀ {k m : Nat}, k ≤ m → reachSet g u k ⊆ reachSet g u m := by
  intro k m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro h
    have hk : k = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp h
    subst hk
    exact fun x hx => hx
  | succ m ih =>
    intro h
    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le h with heq | hlt
    · subst heq
      exact fun x hx => hx
    · have hkm : k ≤ m := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hlt
      have h1 := ih hkm
      intro x hx
      rw [reachSet_succ]
      exact subset_expand _ (h1 hx)

theorem reachSet_subset_range {g : SCCGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {u : Nat}
    (hu : u < g.adj.size) : ∀ (k : Nat), reachSet g u k ⊆ Finset.range g.adj.size := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    rw [reachSet_zero]
    intro x hx
    have hxu : x = u := by simpa using hx
    subst hxu
    simpa using hu
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [reachSet_succ]
    intro x hx
    simp only [expand, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion] at hx
    rcases hx with hx | ⟨w, hw, hx⟩
    · exact ih hx
    · have hw' : w < g.adj.size := Finset.mem_range.mp (ih hw)
      have hedge := mem_outNbrs.mp hx
      exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (hwf w hw' x hedge.2)

theorem card_lower {g : SCCGraph} {u : Nat}
    (hne : ∀ k, k ≤ g.adj.size → reachSet g u (k + 1) ≠ reachSet g u k) :
    ∀ k, k ≤ g.adj.size → k + 1 ≤ (reachSet g u k).card := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro _
    rw [reachSet_zero]
    simp
  | succ k ih =>
    intro hk
    have hk' : k ≤ g.adj.size := Nat.le_of_succ_le hk
    have h1 := ih hk'
    have hsub : reachSet g u k ⊆ reachSet g u (k + 1) := reachSet_mono (Nat.le_succ k)
    have hne' : reachSet g u k ≠ reachSet g u (k + 1) := fun hh => hne k hk' hh.symm
    have hss : reachSet g u k ⊂ reachSet g u (k + 1) := by
      first
        | exact Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨hsub, hne'⟩
        | exact lt_of_le_of_ne hsub hne'
        | exact HasSubset.Subset.ssubset_of_ne hsub hne'
    have h2 := Finset.card_lt_card hss
    omega

theorem exists_stable {g : SCCGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {u : Nat} (hu : u < g.adj.size) :
    ∃ k, k ≤ g.adj.size ∧ reachSet g u (k + 1) = reachSet g u k := by
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc
  have h1 := card_lower (g := g) (u := u) (fun k hk => hc k hk) g.adj.size (le_refl _)
  have h2 : (reachSet g u g.adj.size).card ≤ (Finset.range g.adj.size).card :=
    Finset.card_le_card (reachSet_subset_range hwf hu g.adj.size)
  rw [Finset.card_range] at h2
  omega

theorem stable_forever {g : SCCGraph} {u k : Nat}
    (h : reachSet g u (k + 1) = reachSet g u k) :
    ∀ m, k ≤ m → reachSet g u m = reachSet g u k := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro hm
    have hk : k = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hm
    subst hk
    rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    intro hm
    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hm with heq | hlt
    · rw [heq]
    · have hkm : k ≤ m := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hlt
      have h1 : reachSet g u m = reachSet g u k := ih hkm
      calc reachSet g u (m + 1) = expand g (reachSet g u m) := reachSet_succ g u m
        _ = expand g (reachSet g u k) := by rw [h1]
        _ = reachSet g u (k + 1) := (reachSet_succ g u k).symm
        _ = reachSet g u k := h

theorem expand_reachSet {g : SCCGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {u : Nat} (hu : u < g.adj.size) :
    expand g (reachSet g u g.adj.size) = reachSet g u g.adj.size := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hstab⟩ := exists_stable hwf hu
  have h1 : reachSet g u g.adj.size = reachSet g u k := stable_forever hstab _ hk
  have h2 : reachSet g u (g.adj.size + 1) = reachSet g u k :=
    stable_forever hstab _ (Nat.le_succ_of_le hk)
  calc expand g (reachSet g u g.adj.size)
      = reachSet g u (g.adj.size + 1) := (reachSet_succ g u g.adj.size).symm
    _ = reachSet g u k := h2
    _ = reachSet g u g.adj.size := h1.symm

theorem reach_refl {g : SCCGraph} (u : Nat) : u ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size := by
  have h0 : u ∈ reachSet g u 0 := by
    rw [reachSet_zero]
    simp
  exact reachSet_mono (Nat.zero_le _) h0

theorem reach_trans {g : SCCGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {u v w : Nat} (hu : u < g.adj.size)
    (h1 : v ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size) (h2 : w ∈ reachSet g v g.adj.size) :
    w ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size := by
  have key : ∀ k, reachSet g v k ⊆ reachSet g u g.adj.size := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      rw [reachSet_zero]
      intro x hx
      have hxv : x = v := by simpa using hx
      subst hxv
      exact h1
    | succ k ih =>
      intro x hx
      rw [reachSet_succ] at hx
      have hx2 : x ∈ expand g (reachSet g u g.adj.size) := expand_mono ih hx
      rwa [expand_reachSet hwf hu] at hx2
  exact key _ h2

theorem reach_of_edge {g : SCCGraph} {u v : Nat} (h : g.has_edge u v) :
    v ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size := by
  have hu : u < g.adj.size := h.1
  have h0 : v ∈ expand g (reachSet g u 0) := by
    simp only [expand, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion]
    refine Or.inr ⟨u, ?_, mem_outNbrs.mpr h⟩
    rw [reachSet_zero]
    simp
  have h1 : v ∈ reachSet g u (0 + 1) := by
    rw [reachSet_succ]
    exact h0
  exact reachSet_mono (by omega) h1

/-! ### List helper lemmas -/

theorem getD_zero (x : Nat) (t : List Nat) : (x :: t).getD 0 0 = x := by
  first
    | rfl
    | simp
    | simp [List.getD]

theorem getD_succ (x : Nat) (t : List Nat) (i : Nat) :
    (x :: t).getD (i + 1) 0 = t.getD i 0 := by
  first
    | rfl
    | simp
    | simp [List.getD]

theorem head?_cons (x : Nat) (t : List Nat) : (x :: t).head? = some x := by
  first
    | rfl
    | simp

theorem getLast?_singleton' (x : Nat) : ([x] : List Nat).getLast? = some x := by
  first
    | rfl
    | simp

theorem getLast?_cc (x y : Nat) (t : List Nat) :
    (x :: y :: t).getLast? = (y :: t).getLast? := by
  first
    | rfl
    | simp
    | simp [List.getLast?_cons_cons]

theorem getLast?_snoc : ∀ (l : List Nat) (v : Nat), (l ++ [v]).getLast? = some v := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro v
    first
      | rfl
      | simp
  | cons x t ih =>
    intro v
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      first
        | rfl
        | simp
    | cons y t' =>
      have h1 : ((x :: y :: t') ++ [v]).getLast? = (y :: (t' ++ [v])).getLast? := by
        show (x :: y :: (t' ++ [v])).getLast? = (y :: (t' ++ [v])).getLast?
        exact getLast?_cc x y (t' ++ [v])
      rw [h1]
      exact ih v

theorem chain_of_idx (g : SCCGraph) : ∀ (p : List Nat),
    (∀ i, i + 1 < p.length → g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)) ↔
      List.Chain' g.has_edge p := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil =>
    constructor
    · intro _
      first
        | exact List.Chain'.nil
        | trivial
        | simp
    · intro _ i hi
      simp at hi
  | cons x t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      constructor
      · intro _
        first
          | exact List.Chain.nil
          | trivial
          | simp
      · intro _ i hi
        simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hi
        omega
    | cons y t' =>
      rw [List.chain'_cons, ← ih]
      constructor
      · intro h
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · have e := h 0 (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)
          first
            | (rw [getD_zero, getD_succ, getD_zero] at e; exact e)
            | (simp only [getD_zero, getD_succ] at e; exact e)
            | simpa [getD_zero, getD_succ] using e
        · intro i hi
          have e := h (i + 1) (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢; omega)
          first
            | (rw [getD_succ, getD_succ] at e; exact e)
            | (simp only [getD_succ] at e; exact e)
            | simpa [getD_succ] using e
      · intro h i hi
        cases i with
        | zero =>
          have hh := h.1
          first
            | (rw [getD_zero, getD_succ, getD_zero]; exact hh)
            | (simp only [getD_zero, getD_succ]; exact hh)
            | simpa [getD_zero, getD_succ] using hh
        | succ j =>
          have hh := h.2 j (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢; omega)
          first
            | (rw [getD_succ, getD_succ]; exact hh)
            | (simp only [getD_succ]; exact hh)
            | simpa [getD_succ] using hh

theorem is_path_iff_chain (g : SCCGraph) (p : List Nat) :
    g.is_path p ↔ (p ≠ [] ∧ List.Chain' g.has_edge p) := by
  unfold SCCGraph.is_path
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨?_, (chain_of_idx g p).mp h2⟩
    cases p with
    | nil => simp at h1
    | cons a t => simp
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨?_, (chain_of_idx g p).mpr h2⟩
    cases p with
    | nil => exact absurd rfl h1
    | cons a t => simp

theorem chain_snoc (g : SCCGraph) : ∀ (l : List Nat) (w v : Nat),
    List.Chain' g.has_edge l → l.getLast? = some w → g.has_edge w v →
    List.Chain' g.has_edge (l ++ [v]) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro w v _ hl _
    simp at hl
  | cons x t ih =>
    intro w v hc hl he
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      have hx : x = w := Option.some_inj.mp ((getLast?_singleton' x).symm.trans hl)
      subst hx
      refine List.chain'_cons.mpr ⟨he, ?_⟩
      first
        | exact List.Chain.nil
        | trivial
        | simp
    | cons y t' =>
      rw [List.chain'_cons] at hc
      have hl' : (y :: t').getLast? = some w := by
        rw [← getLast?_cc x y t']
        exact hl
      have hrec := ih w v hc.2 hl' he
      refine List.chain'_cons.mpr ⟨hc.1, ?_⟩
      exact hrec

theorem has_path_snoc {g : SCCGraph} {u w v : Nat} (h1 : g.has_path u w)
    (h2 : g.has_edge w v) : g.has_path u v := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hh, hl⟩ := h1
  rw [is_path_iff_chain] at hp
  obtain ⟨hne, hc⟩ := hp
  cases p with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl hne
  | cons x t =>
    have hx : x = u := Option.some_inj.mp ((head?_cons x t).symm.trans hh)
    refine ⟨(x :: t) ++ [v], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [is_path_iff_chain]
      refine ⟨?_, chain_snoc g (x :: t) w v hc hl h2⟩
      simp
    · have hh2 : ((x :: t) ++ [v]).head? = some x := by
        show (x :: (t ++ [v])).head? = some x
        exact head?_cons x (t ++ [v])
      rw [hh2, hx]
    · exact getLast?_snoc (x :: t) v

theorem has_path_of_mem_reachSet {g : SCCGraph} (u : Nat) :
    ∀ (k v : Nat), v ∈ reachSet g u k → g.has_path u v := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro v hv
    rw [reachSet_zero] at hv
    have hvu : v = u := by simpa using hv
    refine ⟨[u], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [is_path_iff_chain]
      refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
      first
        | exact List.Chain.nil
        | trivial
        | simp
    · exact head?_cons u []
    · rw [getLast?_singleton' u, hvu]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro v hv
    rw [reachSet_succ] at hv
    simp only [expand, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion] at hv
    rcases hv with hv | ⟨w, hw, hv⟩
    · exact ih v hv
    · exact has_path_snoc (ih w hw) (mem_outNbrs.mp hv)

theorem reach_of_chain {g : SCCGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat), List.Chain' g.has_edge p → ∀ (u v : Nat),
      p.head? = some u → p.getLast? = some v → v ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil =>
    intro _ u v hh _
    simp at hh
  | cons x t ih =>
    intro hc u v hh hl
    have hx : x = u := Option.some_inj.mp ((head?_cons x t).symm.trans hh)
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      have hv : x = v := Option.some_inj.mp ((getLast?_singleton' x).symm.trans hl)
      rw [← hx, ← hv]
      exact reach_refl x
    | cons y t' =>
      rw [List.chain'_cons] at hc
      have hl' : (y :: t').getLast? = some v := by
        rw [← getLast?_cc x y t']
        exact hl
      have hy : v ∈ reachSet g y g.adj.size := ih hc.2 y v (head?_cons y t') hl'
      have hxy : y ∈ reachSet g x g.adj.size := reach_of_edge hc.1
      have hres : v ∈ reachSet g x g.adj.size := reach_trans hwf hc.1.1 hxy hy
      rw [← hx]
      exact hres

theorem reach_of_path {g : SCCGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {u v : Nat}
    (h : g.has_path u v) : v ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hh, hl⟩ := h
  rw [is_path_iff_chain] at hp
  exact reach_of_chain hwf p hp.2 u v hh hl

theorem mem_sccOf {g : SCCGraph} {u v : Nat} :
    v ∈ sccOf g u ↔
      (v < g.adj.size ∧ v ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size ∧ u ∈ reachSet g v g.adj.size) := by
  unfold sccOf Rch
  rw [List.mem_filter]
  simp [List.mem_range, and_assoc]

theorem sccOf_eq {g : SCCGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {a b : Nat}
    (ha : a < g.adj.size) (hb : b < g.adj.size)
    (hab : b ∈ reachSet g a g.adj.size) (hba : a ∈ reachSet g b g.adj.size) :
    sccOf g a = sccOf g b := by
  have hfun : (fun v => Rch g a v && Rch g v a) = (fun v => Rch g b v && Rch g v b) := by
    funext v
    by_cases hv : v < g.adj.size
    · have hiff : (v ∈ reachSet g a g.adj.size ∧ a ∈ reachSet g v g.adj.size) ↔
          (v ∈ reachSet g b g.adj.size ∧ b ∈ reachSet g v g.adj.size) := by
        constructor
        · intro h
          exact ⟨reach_trans hwf hb hba h.1, reach_trans hwf hv h.2 hab⟩
        · intro h
          exact ⟨reach_trans hwf ha hab h.1, reach_trans hwf hv h.2 hba⟩
      have hdec : (decide (v ∈ reachSet g a g.adj.size ∧ a ∈ reachSet g v g.adj.size)) =
          (decide (v ∈ reachSet g b g.adj.size ∧ b ∈ reachSet g v g.adj.size)) :=
        decide_eq_decide.mpr hiff
      first
        | simpa [Rch, Bool.decide_and] using hdec
        | (rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff]
           simp only [Rch, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
           exact hiff)
    · have h1 : Rch g a v = false := by
        simp only [Rch, decide_eq_false_iff_not]
        intro hmem
        exact hv (Finset.mem_range.mp (reachSet_subset_range hwf ha g.adj.size hmem))
      have h2 : Rch g b v = false := by
        simp only [Rch, decide_eq_false_iff_not]
        intro hmem
        exact hv (Finset.mem_range.mp (reachSet_subset_range hwf hb g.adj.size hmem))
      rw [h1, h2]
      simp
  unfold sccOf
  first
    | rw [hfun]
    | (congr 1; exact hfun)
    | simp only [hfun]

end SCCImpl

theorem find_sccs_postcond_satisfied (graph : SCCGraph)
    (h_precond : find_sccs_precond graph) :
    find_sccs_postcond graph (find_sccs graph h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have hwf : graph.well_formed := h_precond.1
  have hmem : ∀ c, c ∈ find_sccs graph h_precond ↔
      ∃ a, a < graph.adj.size ∧ SCCImpl.sccOf graph a = c := by
    intro c
    unfold find_sccs
    rw [List.mem_dedup, List.mem_map]
    simp [List.mem_range]

structure SCCGraph where

def SCCGraph.well_formed (g : SCCGraph) : Prop :=

structure SCCGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def SCCGraph.well_formed (g : SCCGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def SCCGraph.size (g : SCCGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def SCCGraph.has_edge (g : SCCGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def SCCGraph.is_path (g : SCCGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def SCCGraph.has_path (g : SCCGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v

def SCCGraph.is_strongly_connected (g : SCCGraph) (comp : List Nat) : Prop :=
  comp.length > 0 ∧
  (∀ u, u ∈ comp → u < g.size) ∧
  ∀ u v, u ∈ comp → v ∈ comp →
    (g.has_path u v ∧ g.has_path v u)

def SCCGraph.is_partition (g : SCCGraph) (sccs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  sccs.Nodup ∧ 
  (∀ u, u < g.size → ∃ comp, comp ∈ sccs ∧ u ∈ comp) ∧
  (∀ c1 c2, c1 ∈ sccs → c2 ∈ sccs → c1 ≠ c2 →
    ∀ u, u ∈ c1 → u ∉ c2)

def SCCGraph.scc_has_path (g : SCCGraph) (c1 c2 : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ u v, u ∈ c1 ∧ v ∈ c2 ∧ g.has_path u v

def SCCGraph.is_maximal_scc_structure (g : SCCGraph) (sccs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∀ c1 c2, c1 ∈ sccs → c2 ∈ sccs → c1 ≠ c2 →
    (g.scc_has_path c1 c2 → ¬ g.scc_has_path c2 c1)

def SCCGraph.is_valid_scc_result (g : SCCGraph) (sccs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  g.is_partition sccs ∧
  (∀ c, c ∈ sccs → g.is_strongly_connected c) ∧

  constructor

    refine ⟨?_, (chain_of_idx g p).mpr h2⟩
    cases p with
    | nil => exact absurd rfl h1
    | cons a t => simp

theorem chain_snoc (g : SCCGraph) : ∀ (l : List Nat) (w v : Nat),
    List.Chain' g.has_edge l → l.getLast? = some w → g.has_edge w v →
    List.Chain' g.has_edge (l ++ [v]) := by
  intro l
  induction l with

  | cons x t ih =>
    intro w v hc hl he
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      have hx : x = w := Option.some_inj.mp ((getLast?_single x).symm.trans hl)

      refine List.chain'_cons.mpr ⟨he, ?_⟩
      first | exact List.Chain.nil | trivial | simp
    | cons y t' =>
      rw [List.chain'_cons] at hc
      have hl' : (y :: t').getLast? = some w := by
        rw [← getLast?_cc x y t']; exact hl
      exact List.chain'_cons.mpr ⟨hc.1, ih w v hc.2 hl' he⟩

  rw [is_path_iff_chain] at hp
  obtain ⟨hne, hc⟩ := hp
  cases p with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl hne
  | cons x t =>
    have hx : x = u := Option.some_inj.mp ((head?_cons x t).symm.trans hh)
    refine ⟨(x :: t) ++ [v], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [is_path_iff_chain]
      exact ⟨by simp, chain_snoc g (x :: t) w v hc hl h2⟩
    · have hh2 : ((x :: t) ++ [v]).head? = some x := by
        show (x :: (t ++ [v])).head? = some x
        exact head?_cons x (t ++ [v])
      rw [hh2, hx]
    · exact getLast?_snoc (x :: t) v

  induction k with

    intro v hv
    rw [reachSet_zero] at hv
    have hvu : v = u := by simpa using hv
    refine ⟨[u], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [is_path_iff_chain]
      refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
      first | exact List.Chain.nil | trivial | simp
    · exact head?_cons u []
    · rw [getLast?_single u, hvu]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro v hv
    rw [reachSet_succ] at hv
    simp only [expand, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion] at hv

    | cons y t' =>

      have hl' : (y :: t').getLast? = some v := by
        rw [← getLast?_cc x y t']; exact hl

      have hres : v ∈ reachSet g x g.adj.size :=
        reach_trans hwf hc.1.1 (reach_of_edge hc.1) hy
      rw [← hx]
      exact hres

  obtain ⟨p, hp, hh, hl⟩ := h
  rw [is_path_iff_chain] at hp
  exact reach_of_chain hwf p hp.2 u v hh hl

import Mathlib

structure SCCGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def SCCGraph.well_formed (g : SCCGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def SCCGraph.size (g : SCCGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def SCCGraph.has_edge (g : SCCGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def SCCGraph.is_path (g : SCCGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def SCCGraph.has_path (g : SCCGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v

def SCCGraph.is_strongly_connected (g : SCCGraph) (comp : List Nat) : Prop :=
  comp.length > 0 ∧
  (∀ u, u ∈ comp → u < g.size) ∧
  ∀ u v, u ∈ comp → v ∈ comp →
    (g.has_path u v ∧ g.has_path v u)

def SCCGraph.is_partition (g : SCCGraph) (sccs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  sccs.Nodup ∧
  (∀ u, u < g.size → ∃ comp, comp ∈ sccs ∧ u ∈ comp) ∧
  (∀ c1 c2, c1 ∈ sccs → c2 ∈ sccs → c1 ≠ c2 →
    ∀ u, u ∈ c1 → u ∉ c2)

def SCCGraph.scc_has_path (g : SCCGraph) (c1 c2 : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ u v, u ∈ c1 ∧ v ∈ c2 ∧ g.has_path u v

def SCCGraph.is_maximal_scc_structure (g : SCCGraph) (sccs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∀ c1 c2, c1 ∈ sccs → c2 ∈ sccs → c1 ≠ c2 →
    (g.scc_has_path c1 c2 → ¬ g.scc_has_path c2 c1)

def SCCGraph.is_valid_scc_result (g : SCCGraph) (sccs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  g.is_partition sccs ∧
  (∀ c, c ∈ sccs → g.is_strongly_connected c) ∧

def outNbrs (g : SCCGraph) (u : Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  if u < g.adj.size then ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList).toFinset else ∅

def expand (g : SCCGraph) (S : Finset Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  S ∪ S.biUnion (fun w => outNbrs g w)

  | 0 => {u}
  | k + 1 => expand g (reachSet g u k)

  decide (v ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size)

  (List.range g.adj.size).filter (fun v => Rch g u v && Rch g v u)

structure SCCGraph where

def SCCGraph.well_formed (g : SCCGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →

def SCCGraph.has_path (g : SCCGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=

def SCCGraph.is_strongly_connected (g : SCCGraph) (comp : List Nat) : Prop :=
  comp.length > 0 ∧
  (∀ u, u ∈ comp → u < g.size) ∧
  ∀ u v, u ∈ comp → v ∈ comp →

import Mathlib

structure SCCGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def SCCGraph.well_formed (g : SCCGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def SCCGraph.size (g : SCCGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def SCCGraph.has_edge (g : SCCGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def SCCGraph.is_path (g : SCCGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def SCCGraph.has_path (g : SCCGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v

def SCCGraph.is_strongly_connected (g : SCCGraph) (comp : List Nat) : Prop :=
  comp.length > 0 ∧
  (∀ u, u ∈ comp → u < g.size) ∧
  ∀ u v, u ∈ comp → v ∈ comp →
    (g.has_path u v ∧ g.has_path v u)

def SCCGraph.is_partition (g : SCCGraph) (sccs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  sccs.Nodup ∧
  (∀ u, u < g.size → ∃ comp, comp ∈ sccs ∧ u ∈ comp) ∧
  (∀ c1 c2, c1 ∈ sccs → c2 ∈ sccs → c1 ≠ c2 →
    ∀ u, u ∈ c1 → u ∉ c2)

def SCCGraph.scc_has_path (g : SCCGraph) (c1 c2 : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ u v, u ∈ c1 ∧ v ∈ c2 ∧ g.has_path u v

def SCCGraph.is_maximal_scc_structure (g : SCCGraph) (sccs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∀ c1 c2, c1 ∈ sccs → c2 ∈ sccs → c1 ≠ c2 →
    (g.scc_has_path c1 c2 → ¬ g.scc_has_path c2 c1)

def SCCGraph.is_valid_scc_result (g : SCCGraph) (sccs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  g.is_partition sccs ∧
  (∀ c, c ∈ sccs → g.is_strongly_connected c) ∧
  g.is_maximal_scc_structure sccs

namespace SCCImpl

def outNbrs (g : SCCGraph) (u : Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  if u < g.adj.size then ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList).toFinset else ∅

def expand (g : SCCGraph) (S : Finset Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  S ∪ S.biUnion (fun w => outNbrs g w)

def reachSet (g : SCCGraph) (u : Nat) : Nat → Finset Nat
  | 0 => {u}
  | k + 1 => expand g (reachSet g u k)

def Rch (g : SCCGraph) (u v : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (v ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size)

def sccOf (g : SCCGraph) (u : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range g.adj.size).filter (fun v => Rch g u v && Rch g v u)

end SCCImpl

-- !benchmark @start lemma
namespace SCCImpl

theorem rs0 (g : SCCGraph) (u : Nat) : reachSet g u 0 = {u} := by
  first | rfl | simp [reachSet]

theorem rsS (g : SCCGraph) (u k : Nat) :
    reachSet g u (k + 1) = expand g (reachSet g u k) := by
  first | rfl | simp [reachSet]

theorem mem_outNbrs {g : SCCGraph} {u v : Nat} : v ∈ outNbrs g u ↔ g.has_edge u v := by
  unfold outNbrs SCCGraph.has_edge
  by_cases h : u < g.adj.size
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h]

theorem sub_expand {g : SCCGraph} (S : Finset Nat) : S ⊆ expand g S := by
  intro x hx
  simp only [expand, Finset.mem_union]
  exact Or.inl hx

theorem expand_mono {g : SCCGraph} {S T : Finset Nat} (h : S ⊆ T) :
    expand g S ⊆ expand g T := by
  intro x hx
  simp only [expand, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion] at hx ⊢
  rcases hx with hx | ⟨w, hw, hx⟩
  · exact Or.inl (h hx)
  · exact Or.inr ⟨w, h hw, hx⟩

theorem rs_mono {g : SCCGraph} {u : Nat} :
    ∀ {k m : Nat}, k ≤ m → reachSet g u k ⊆ reachSet g u m := by
  intro k m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro h
    have hk : k = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp h
    subst hk
    exact fun x hx => hx
  | succ m ih =>
    intro h
    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le h with heq | hlt
    · subst heq
      exact fun x hx => hx
    · have h1 := ih (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hlt)
      intro x hx
      rw [rsS]
      exact sub_expand _ (h1 hx)

theorem rs_range {g : SCCGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {u : Nat} (hu : u < g.adj.size) :
    ∀ (k : Nat), reachSet g u k ⊆ Finset.range g.adj.size := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    rw [rs0]
    intro x hx
    have hxu : x = u := by simpa using hx
    subst hxu
    simpa using hu
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [rsS]
    intro x hx
    simp only [expand, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion] at hx
    rcases hx with hx | ⟨w, hw, hx⟩
    · exact ih hx
    · exact Finset.mem_range.mpr
        (hwf w (Finset.mem_range.mp (ih hw)) x (mem_outNbrs.mp hx).2)

theorem card_low {g : SCCGraph} {u : Nat}
    (hne : ∀ k, k ≤ g.adj.size → reachSet g u (k + 1) ≠ reachSet g u k) :
    ∀ k, k ≤ g.adj.size → k + 1 ≤ (reachSet g u k).card := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro _
    rw [rs0]
    simp
  | succ k ih =>
    intro hk
    have hk' : k ≤ g.adj.size := Nat.le_of_succ_le hk
    have h1 := ih hk'
    have hsub : reachSet g u k ⊆ reachSet g u (k + 1) := rs_mono (Nat.le_succ k)
    have hne' : reachSet g u k ≠ reachSet g u (k + 1) := fun hh => hne k hk' hh.symm
    have hss : reachSet g u k ⊂ reachSet g u (k + 1) := by
      first
        | exact Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨hsub, hne'⟩
        | exact lt_of_le_of_ne hsub hne'
    have h2 := Finset.card_lt_card hss
    omega

theorem exists_stable {g : SCCGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {u : Nat} (hu : u < g.adj.size) :
    ∃ k, k ≤ g.adj.size ∧ reachSet g u (k + 1) = reachSet g u k := by
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc
  have h1 := card_low (g := g) (u := u) (fun k hk => hc k hk) g.adj.size (le_refl _)
  have h2 : (reachSet g u g.adj.size).card ≤ (Finset.range g.adj.size).card :=
    Finset.card_le_card (rs_range hwf hu g.adj.size)
  rw [Finset.card_range] at h2
  omega

theorem stable_all {g : SCCGraph} {u k : Nat}
    (h : reachSet g u (k + 1) = reachSet g u k) :
    ∀ m, k ≤ m → reachSet g u m = reachSet g u k := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro hm
    have hk : k = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hm
    subst hk
    rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    intro hm
    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hm with heq | hlt
    · rw [heq]
    · have h1 : reachSet g u m = reachSet g u k := ih (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hlt)
      calc reachSet g u (m + 1) = expand g (reachSet g u m) := rsS g u m
        _ = expand g (reachSet g u k) := by rw [h1]
        _ = reachSet g u (k + 1) := (rsS g u k).symm
        _ = reachSet g u k := h

theorem expand_rs {g : SCCGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {u : Nat} (hu : u < g.adj.size) :
    expand g (reachSet g u g.adj.size) = reachSet g u g.adj.size := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hs⟩ := exists_stable hwf hu
  have h1 : reachSet g u g.adj.size = reachSet g u k := stable_all hs _ hk
  have h2 : reachSet g u (g.adj.size + 1) = reachSet g u k :=
    stable_all hs _ (Nat.le_succ_of_le hk)
  calc expand g (reachSet g u g.adj.size)
      = reachSet g u (g.adj.size + 1) := (rsS g u g.adj.size).symm
    _ = reachSet g u k := h2
    _ = reachSet g u g.adj.size := h1.symm

theorem reach_refl {g : SCCGraph} (u : Nat) : u ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size := by
  have h0 : u ∈ reachSet g u 0 := by
    rw [rs0]
    simp
  exact rs_mono (Nat.zero_le _) h0

theorem reach_trans {g : SCCGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {u v w : Nat} (hu : u < g.adj.size)
    (h1 : v ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size) (h2 : w ∈ reachSet g v g.adj.size) :
    w ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size := by
  have key : ∀ k, reachSet g v k ⊆ reachSet g u g.adj.size := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      rw [rs0]
      intro x hx
      have hxv : x = v := by simpa using hx
      subst hxv
      exact h1
    | succ k ih =>
      intro x hx
      rw [rsS] at hx
      have hx2 : x ∈ expand g (reachSet g u g.adj.size) := expand_mono ih hx
      rwa [expand_rs hwf hu] at hx2
  exact key _ h2

theorem reach_edge {g : SCCGraph} {u v : Nat} (h : g.has_edge u v) :
    v ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size := by
  have hu : u < g.adj.size := h.1
  have h0 : v ∈ expand g (reachSet g u 0) := by
    simp only [expand, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion]
    refine Or.inr ⟨u, ?_, mem_outNbrs.mpr h⟩
    rw [rs0]
    simp
  have h1 : v ∈ reachSet g u (0 + 1) := by
    rw [rsS]
    exact h0
  exact rs_mono (by omega) h1

theorem gD0 (x : Nat) (t : List Nat) : (x :: t).getD 0 0 = x := by
  first | rfl | simp

theorem gDS (x : Nat) (t : List Nat) (i : Nat) :
    (x :: t).getD (i + 1) 0 = t.getD i 0 := by
  first | rfl | simp

theorem hd_cons (x : Nat) (t : List Nat) : (x :: t).head? = some x := by
  first | rfl | simp

theorem last_single (x : Nat) : ([x] : List Nat).getLast? = some x := by
  first | rfl | simp

theorem last_cc (x y : Nat) (t : List Nat) :
    (x :: y :: t).getLast? = (y :: t).getLast? := by
  first | rfl | simp

theorem last_snoc : ∀ (l : List Nat) (v : Nat), (l ++ [v]).getLast? = some v := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro v
    first | rfl | simp
  | cons x t ih =>
    intro v
    cases t with
    | nil => first | rfl | simp
    | cons y t' =>
      have h1 : ((x :: y :: t') ++ [v]).getLast? = (y :: (t' ++ [v])).getLast? := by
        show (x :: y :: (t' ++ [v])).getLast? = (y :: (t' ++ [v])).getLast?
        exact last_cc x y (t' ++ [v])
      rw [h1]
      exact ih v

theorem chain_idx (g : SCCGraph) : ∀ (p : List Nat),
    (∀ i, i + 1 < p.length → g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)) ↔
      List.IsChain g.has_edge p := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil =>
    constructor
    · intro _
      exact List.IsChain.nil
    · intro _ i hi
      simp only [List.length_nil] at hi
      omega
  | cons x t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      constructor
      · intro _
        exact List.IsChain.singleton x
      · intro _ i hi
        simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hi
        omega
    | cons y t' =>
      rw [List.isChain_cons_cons, ← ih]
      constructor
      · intro h
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · have e := h 0 (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)
          first
            | (rw [gD0, gDS, gD0] at e; exact e)
            | (simp only [gD0, gDS] at e; exact e)
            | simpa [gD0, gDS] using e
        · intro i hi
          have e := h (i + 1) (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢; omega)
          first
            | (rw [gDS, gDS] at e; exact e)
            | (simp only [gDS] at e; exact e)
            | simpa [gDS] using e
      · intro h i hi
        cases i with
        | zero =>
          have hh := h.1
          first
            | (rw [gD0, gDS, gD0]; exact hh)
            | (simp only [gD0, gDS]; exact hh)
            | simpa [gD0, gDS] using hh
        | succ j =>
          have hh := h.2 j (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢; omega)
          first
            | (rw [gDS, gDS]; exact hh)
            | (simp only [gDS]; exact hh)
            | simpa [gDS] using hh

theorem path_chain (g : SCCGraph) (p : List Nat) :
    g.is_path p ↔ (p ≠ [] ∧ List.IsChain g.has_edge p) := by
  unfold SCCGraph.is_path
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨?_, (chain_idx g p).mp h2⟩
    cases p with
    | nil => simp at h1
    | cons a t => simp
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨?_, (chain_idx g p).mpr h2⟩
    cases p with
    | nil => exact absurd rfl h1
    | cons a t => simp

theorem chain_snoc (g : SCCGraph) : ∀ (l : List Nat) (w v : Nat),
    List.IsChain g.has_edge l → l.getLast? = some w → g.has_edge w v →
    List.IsChain g.has_edge (l ++ [v]) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro w v _ hl _
    simp at hl
  | cons x t ih =>
    intro w v hc hl he
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      have hx : x = w := Option.some_inj.mp ((last_single x).symm.trans hl)
      subst hx
      refine List.isChain_cons_cons.mpr ⟨he, ?_⟩
      exact List.IsChain.singleton v
    | cons y t' =>
      rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at hc
      have hl' : (y :: t').getLast? = some w := by
        rw [← last_cc x y t']
        exact hl
      exact List.isChain_cons_cons.mpr ⟨hc.1, ih w v hc.2 hl' he⟩

theorem path_snoc {g : SCCGraph} {u w v : Nat} (h1 : g.has_path u w)
    (h2 : g.has_edge w v) : g.has_path u v := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hh, hl⟩ := h1
  rw [path_chain] at hp
  obtain ⟨hne, hc⟩ := hp
  cases p with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl hne
  | cons x t =>
    have hx : x = u := Option.some_inj.mp ((hd_cons x t).symm.trans hh)
    refine ⟨(x :: t) ++ [v], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [path_chain]
      exact ⟨by simp, chain_snoc g (x :: t) w v hc hl h2⟩
    · have hh2 : ((x :: t) ++ [v]).head? = some x := by
        show (x :: (t ++ [v])).head? = some x
        exact hd_cons x (t ++ [v])
      rw [hh2, hx]
    · exact last_snoc (x :: t) v

theorem path_of_mem {g : SCCGraph} (u : Nat) :
    ∀ (k v : Nat), v ∈ reachSet g u k → g.has_path u v := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro v hv
    rw [rs0] at hv
    have hvu : v = u := by simpa using hv
    refine ⟨[u], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [path_chain]
      exact ⟨by simp, List.IsChain.singleton u⟩
    · exact hd_cons u []
    · rw [last_single u, hvu]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro v hv
    rw [rsS] at hv
    simp only [expand, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion] at hv
    rcases hv with hv | ⟨w, hw, hv⟩
    · exact ih v hv
    · exact path_snoc (ih w hw) (mem_outNbrs.mp hv)

theorem mem_of_chain {g : SCCGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat), List.IsChain g.has_edge p → ∀ (u v : Nat),
      p.head? = some u → p.getLast? = some v → v ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil =>
    intro _ u v hh _
    simp at hh
  | cons x t ih =>
    intro hc u v hh hl
    have hx : x = u := Option.some_inj.mp ((hd_cons x t).symm.trans hh)
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      have hv : x = v := Option.some_inj.mp ((last_single x).symm.trans hl)
      rw [← hx, ← hv]
      exact reach_refl x
    | cons y t' =>
      rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at hc
      have hl' : (y :: t').getLast? = some v := by
        rw [← last_cc x y t']
        exact hl
      have hy : v ∈ reachSet g y g.adj.size := ih hc.2 y v (hd_cons y t') hl'
      have hres : v ∈ reachSet g x g.adj.size :=
        reach_trans hwf hc.1.1 (reach_edge hc.1) hy
      rw [← hx]
      exact hres

theorem mem_of_path {g : SCCGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {u v : Nat}
    (h : g.has_path u v) : v ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hh, hl⟩ := h
  rw [path_chain] at hp
  exact mem_of_chain hwf p hp.2 u v hh hl

theorem mem_sccOf {g : SCCGraph} {u v : Nat} :
    v ∈ sccOf g u ↔
      (v < g.adj.size ∧ v ∈ reachSet g u g.adj.size ∧ u ∈ reachSet g v g.adj.size) := by
  unfold sccOf Rch
  rw [List.mem_filter]
  simp [List.mem_range]

theorem sccOf_eq {g : SCCGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {a b : Nat}
    (ha : a < g.adj.size) (hb : b < g.adj.size)
    (hab : b ∈ reachSet g a g.adj.size) (hba : a ∈ reachSet g b g.adj.size) :
    sccOf g a = sccOf g b := by
  have hfun : (fun v => Rch g a v && Rch g v a) = (fun v => Rch g b v && Rch g v b) := by
    funext v
    by_cases hv : v < g.adj.size
    · have hiff : (v ∈ reachSet g a g.adj.size ∧ a ∈ reachSet g v g.adj.size) ↔
          (v ∈ reachSet g b g.adj.size ∧ b ∈ reachSet g v g.adj.size) := by
        constructor
        · intro h
          exact ⟨reach_trans hwf hb hba h.1, reach_trans hwf hv h.2 hab⟩
        · intro h
          exact ⟨reach_trans hwf ha hab h.1, reach_trans hwf hv h.2 hba⟩
      have hdec : (decide (v ∈ reachSet g a g.adj.size ∧ a ∈ reachSet g v g.adj.size)) =
          (decide (v ∈ reachSet g b g.adj.size ∧ b ∈ reachSet g v g.adj.size)) :=
        decide_eq_decide.mpr hiff
      first
        | simpa [Rch, Bool.decide_and] using hdec
        | (rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff]
           simp only [Rch, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
           exact hiff)
    · have h1 : Rch g a v = false := by
        simp only [Rch, decide_eq_false_iff_not]
        intro hm
        exact hv (Finset.mem_range.mp (rs_range hwf ha g.adj.size hm))
      have h2 : Rch g b v = false := by
        simp only [Rch, decide_eq_false_iff_not]
        intro hm
        exact hv (Finset.mem_range.mp (rs_range hwf hb g.adj.size hm))
      rw [h1, h2]
      simp
  unfold sccOf
  rw [hfun]

end SCCImpl

theorem find_sccs_postcond_satisfied (graph : SCCGraph)

-- !benchmark @start proof

  · unfold find_sccs
    exact List.nodup_dedup _

    have hu' : u < graph.adj.size := hu
    exact ⟨SCCImpl.sccOf graph u, (hmem _).mpr ⟨u, hu', rfl⟩, hself u hu'⟩
  · intro c1 c2 h1 h2 hne u hu1 hu2
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hac⟩ := (hmem c1).mp h1
